hero.badge: Fullstack Web Developer • Open for Work
hero.subtitle: Hi, I'm Gábor Németh — a fullstack developer working mainly with Laravel and React. I currently have open capacity and I'm happy to take on websites and web applications in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Laravel, as well as other kinds of projects. I work on both a project and hourly basis, with rates discussed by message.

about.titleHighlight: and I've been learning and building projects ever since.
paragraphs: I studied frontend and later fullstack development at Ruander Educational Center, alongside Udemy courses — and by the end, web development had become a real passion.

Since then I've worked on freelance projects, built a real-time 3D manufacturing monitoring system for Robert Bosch, and worked on Packli, a Hungarian parcel logistics platform — first as an employee, and now I continue that work on a freelance basis. It's the project I'm proudest of: leading the webshop integration work and building an invoice cost-verification feature from scratch.

I currently have open capacity as a freelancer: I'm happy to take on new websites, web applications, or other development projects, either on a project basis or hourly — rates are discussed directly by message.
Outside of work, I enjoy building my own projects end to end: a shopping list app, and a few websites.
about.quote: I enjoy building web applications that are fast, transparent, and reliable.

items.title: ShopList — Shopping List App
items.description: A full-stack shopping list application with a Laravel REST API backend and React frontend, featuring authentication, email confirmation, and drag-and-drop list reordering. Live in production at shoplist.hu.

items.title: Cigar Rating Site
items.description: A cigar review website built in PHP, using CSV-based data storage.

items.title: React-Tailwind Business Website

items.title: 50 Shades of the Room
items.description: A home renovation business website, available in Hungarian and Spanish.

items.title: Outlaw Band Website
items.description: The official website for my own blues-rock band, Outlaw.

experience.description: My journey so far as a Fullstack Web Developer.

items.description: Actively taking on websites and web applications (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Laravel) on a project or hourly basis for friends and clients, including a bilingual home renovation business site and a lash stylist website, alongside personal projects such as ShopList.hu.

Working on a Hungarian parcel logistics SaaS platform, integrating courier services (MPL, DPD, GLS, FoxPost, Packeta) and webshop systems (Shopify, Shoprenter, UNAS, WooCommerce). Led the webshop integration work and built an invoice cost-verification feature — this work now continues on a freelance basis.
Built a real-time 3D manufacturing monitoring system visualizing 100+ machines on the factory floor, including database-driven management of their associated components.

items.quote: It was great working with Gábor — he always responded quickly to requests and paid attention to even the smallest details. The end result exceeded all our expectations.
items.author: Péter Kovács

items.quote: Working together went smoothly from start to finish. Gábor was technically skilled and also explained the options clearly, always finding a practical solution to any problem.
items.author: Tamás Nagy

items.quote: We're very happy with Gábor's work. The website was delivered on time, and it turned out modern, fast, and easy to use. We'll definitely work with him again on future developments.
items.author: Anna Szabó
